section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participant selection process. It began with an initial sample of 14,056 participants who completed the YBIS. After exclusions for age, incomplete data, and country of residence, the final sample for Study X comprised 9,667 participants, consisting of 8,925 US residents and 742 non-US residents from Canada, the United Kingdom, and Australia. The section also notes that all respondent BMIs ranged between 10.13 and 44.98 kg/m².
section_summary.evidence_source: The total sample initially comprised 14,056 participants who completed the YBIS between September and December 2012, of whom 11,321 were US residents and 2,735 were non-US residents. Following ethical stipulations, we excluded from analyses participants who were under 18 years of age (n = 3,058). Furthermore, we only used participants who provided complete datasets with regard to the hypothesized model, leaving 8,925 US residents and 1,900 non-US residents. We further checked whether participants reported implausible BMIs, operationalised as <7 kg/m² or > 60 kg/m² (Young et al. 2001), but all respondent BMIs ranged between 10.13 and 44.98 kg/m². Non-US residents originated from 135 different countries (113 participants did not provide information about their country of residence). Of these participants, only three countries provided participants above a 5 % threshold, namely Canada (22.0 %), United Kingdom (14.2 %), and Australia (5.3 %). We, therefore, limited our analyses in the non-US sample to residents of these three countries. Therefore, the final datasets comprised 8,925 US residents and 742 non-US residents. Characteristics of the final samples are reported in Table 1.
